title_fr: Indice de satisfaction envers la police
population_statement: Among respondents to an open, self-selected online survey of adults. Results describe the people who took part, not Tunisians as a whole.
ethics_review: None. No external ethics review has taken place. DeepTunisia is a young, independent and unfunded project, and approaching an ethics board or an accredited auditor is not yet possible for us. The study has been reviewed only by the project's maintainers and the AI tools they work with. Reviewers are invited to examine the instrument, the code and the participant protections, and we will publish and act on what they find.
data_protection_review: None. No external data-protection review has taken place, for the same reasons. Only the project's maintainers and the AI tools they work with have reviewed the design. The privacy text describes exactly what is stored. The code is open, so anyone can check those statements against it, and we will correct them if they are wrong.
preregistration: This study's own preregistration document, frozen and timestamped before the first answer, including the dated amendment that makes October 2026 a partial first month. Commit 1d11ee9792f0d87bfd421a98cf03d9946ad52194, 23 October 2026.
